column1: # Polar ring galaxies -- Iodice, Arnaboldi, Bournaud, Combes, Sparke, van Driel, Capaccioli 2003,
# ApJ 585, 730 "Polar Ring Galaxies and the Tully-Fisher Relation: Implications for the Dark Halo Shape",
# Table 1, transcribed from the arXiv preprint astro-ph/0211281 (pdftotext -layout of arxiv.org/pdf/astro-ph/0211281).
# Columns: name, PRC catalogue id, heliocentric velocity (km/s), absolute Kn magnitude, absolute B magnitude,
#          HI linewidth at 20% of peak (km/s), reference code for dV20.
# Distance-dependent quantities in the source assume H0 = 75 km/s/Mpc.  Blank M_Kn = not measured.
# The HI traces the POLAR structure, the K light the HOST galaxy -- that decoupling is the point of the paper.
